name: Tere Bin
description: Life takes an unexpected turn for Meerab and Murtasim, as they are bound to face each other. As they fight the battles of ego, hate and self respect with each other, will they understand their true feelings for each other?

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Meerab's wish of becoming a lawyer awaits her elders' approval. Yet, nothing stops her from taking a stand for the vulnerable until Murtasim shows up.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Meerab's world comes crashing down when her wedding is announced on her 21st birthday. Murtasim expresses disgust at his other cousin's feelings for him.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Meerab and Murtasim speak their minds despite their family's decision. Haya has an emotional breakdown after constant rejection from Murtasim.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Haya faces a backlash for expressing her feelings. Meerab finds out that she was only an adopted child.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Meerab's biological father enters the picture when Murtasim questions her past. Murtasim regrets abusing Meerab physically.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Meerab is left at the mercy of her fiance and their relatives when her guardians are asked to leave for Karachi without her.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Meerab reconsiders her decision after a short trip to Karachi, but Murtasim refuses to give in to family pressure.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Haya refuses to give up on Murtasim even as his wedding festivities begin.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Meerab states an unusual condition for agreeing to marry Murtasim.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Meerab confronts Murtasim the next day for staying out on their wedding night.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Meerab violates another norm just when Murtasim starts to get drawn to her beauty.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Murtasim fails to flatter Meerab even with harmless banter but makes sure to set some boundaries with those who hurt her.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Meerab pulls a risky prank on Murtasim after giving Haya a reality check.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Meerab is afraid she might catch feelings for Murtasim.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Meerab has to choose between joining Murtasim on his trip or following his mother's instructions at home.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Murtasim tries to trace Meerab after she goes missing without a warning.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Meerab's admirer shows up at her father's door in search of answers. Murtasim makes it out alive from his rival's territory

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Meerab challenges Murtasim's decision in front of his community, without fully understanding the matter.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Meerab is made to leave Murtasim's house when a disagreement puts him through a near-death experience.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Maryam's courage reunites her brother and Meerab when everyone else starts seeing the good in their separation.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Meerab and Murtasim's reunion compels Haya to resort to witchcraft.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Meerab senses something eerie in the house right after her first dinner date with Murtasim.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Meerab runs into someone she knew back in her single days.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: A little food poisoning gives Meerab's in-laws false hopes.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Murtasim confronts Meerab about the news of her pregnancy as she never consented to getting intimate.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Murtasim discards the contract to save Meerab from accountability when Haya exposes them in front of the family.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Haya is banished to her village when the truth comes out about her conspiracies and witchcraft.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Meerab and Murtasim's visit to Karachi gives Rohail the courage to approach her again.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Murtasim refuses to believe Meerab's side of the story no matter what she does.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Meerab finds something suspicious about Maryam's room and confronts her.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Haya finds a way to break off her own engagement the day Maryam introduces her lover to Meerab.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Maryam's lover gets another reason to convince her to run away with him despite Meerab's effort to do it the right way.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Meerab gives her word to Anas to stop Maryam from running away with him.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Maryam finds out who her culprit is when her wedding is finalized but not to Anas.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Meerab violates house rules once more to help Maryam. Haya stoops to another low.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: Murtasim encourages Meerab to pursue her goals. Meerab considers his sister's defeat her own.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: Murtasim and his mother agree to meet Anas. It turns out that Haya knows more about Anas than Maryam or Meerab.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: Maryam's last hope runs out when Murtasim goes to meet Anas and returns disappointed.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: Meerab meets Anas for a background check, which encourages her to take the next step.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: Maryam finds out how wrong she was when her lover reveals his identity.

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: Murtasim is still clueless about Maryam's whereabouts after Malik Mukhtar disowns his own son.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: Murtasim is compelled to surrender control after his own wife is exposed for betrayal.

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: Meerab's guardians find her abandoned outside their house and learn about her side of the story.

videos.title: Episode 44
videos.overview: Waqas takes a stand for Meerab when even her biological father fails to understand her stance.

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: Meerab reunites with Rohail too soon, unaware that Murtasim had just reached to take her home.

videos.title: Episode 46
videos.overview: Meerab is brought home as part of Maryam's condition for marriage. Haya's interference leads to greater chaos.

videos.title: Episode 47
videos.overview: Meerab and Murtasim find themselves in a vulnerable situation that might save or wreck their marriage.

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: Murtasim spends the night out which buys Meerab enough time for an unannounced departure to Karachi. Maryam's husband confronts her family the next day.

videos.title: Episode 49
videos.overview: Murtasim sets out in search of Meerab while she looks out for a place he can't find her.

videos.title: Episode 50
videos.overview: Meerab remains at the mercy of strangers to hide from Murtasim, unaware of what she lost in the process.

videos.title: Episode 51
videos.overview: Meerab gets familiar with the man who rescues her twice and the people in his life.

videos.title: Episode 52
videos.overview: Meerab tells half the truth when Farrukh Dil asks her about Murtasim Khan.

videos.title: Episode 53
videos.overview: Murtasim comes close to finding Meerab, unaware that he is also being deprived of fatherhood.

videos.title: Episode 54
videos.overview: Meerab may have to explore surgical methods for her child's birth but it comes with many other risks.

videos.title: Episode 55
videos.overview: Murtasim embarks on a new relationship, albeit with mixed feelings. Meanwhile, Meerab welcomes a precious addition to her family.

videos.title: Episode 56
videos.overview: Murtasim realizes it's not too late when he finds out more about Meerab and Rohail two years later.

videos.title: Episode 57
videos.overview: Meerab is reluctant to make a decision on whether to return to Murtasim or not. On the other hand, Murtasim is unable to forget Meerab.

videos.title: Episode 58
videos.overview: Haya's worst nightmare comes true as Meerab walks in with baby Meesam just when Murtasim was about to remarry.
